description_en: Removes IP entries from the network access control list (ACL) of a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
description_zh: 删除访问控制策略组中的IP条目
kebab_example: aliyun slb remove-access-control-list-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-bp1l0kk4gxce43k000000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveAccessControlListEntry

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the network ACL is created.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network ACL
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP entries that you want to remove from the network ACL. Valid values:

entry: the IP address or CIDR block that you want to remove from the network ACL. Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with commas (,).

comment: the description of the network ACL
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问控制策略组。取值：

entry：访问控制策略组中的IP条目，可以指定IP地址或IP地址段（CIDR block），多个IP地址或地址段之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

comment：访问控制策略组备注说明
parameters.name: acl_entrys
